findings.description: `describeRawInvisible` inserts the filesystem-derived path into its diagnostic unchanged; `sourceProblems` and the read-error branch do the same. When a `.ts` filename contains a newline or control character, a violation or read failure can split or spoof the one-line report printed by the repository test.
findings.title: Odd filenames corrupt hygiene reports

evidence.explanation: The new walk builds paths directly from directory entries, passes them to `sourceProblems`, and joins returned diagnostics into the assertion message. Neither the raw-character nor invalid-UTF-8 format escapes the path; the read-error format also prints it unchanged.
